title: Tips and cut edges of wave motifs

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines
location.section: Tips and cut edges of wave motifs

slide_intent: Control cropping so a repeated wave retains enough structure to be recognized at the edge of a composition.
strategic_value: Consistent wave tips and cut points can keep Helsinki’s motif legible across differently sized surfaces.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section shows a two-rule list and diagrams comparing how wave tips and edge cuts meet a surface.
practical_value: Count complete tips and compare the crop with the supplied diagrams before finalizing the divider.

content_islands.name: Tip and crop rules
content_islands.spec: Place the two bullets above the diagram.

content_islands.name: Edge examples
content_islands.spec: Show the wave boundaries and their allowed cut positions.

ingredient.name: Wave edge crop
ingredient.role: Retain recognizable rhythm at the surface boundary.
ingredient.application: Include at least two whole tips and follow the depicted cut positions.
ingredient.scope: The English text says tip or bottom, then describes halfway between extrema; preserve that wording ambiguity and rely on the diagram rather than inventing a clearer numeric rule.

reference_purposes.Application: The diagrams illustrate how wave tips meet surface edges.
reference_purposes.Constraint: At least two whole wave tips are required per surface; the text specifies cutting at tip or bottom and then uses an ambiguous halfway phrase.
